# Grok Bot avatars

Public PNG assets for Grok Bot GitHub comment and pull request branding headers. Reference them with markdown image tags, for example:

```markdown
![Developer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joaobispo2077/avo/main/.github/bot-avatars/developer.png)
```

These files are branding headers for comments and pull requests. They are not application icons.

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `developer.png` | Developer |
| `code-reviewer.png` | Code reviewer |
| `quality-gate-specialist.png` | Quality-gate specialist |
| `quality-gate-devsecops.png` | Quality-gate DevSecOps |
| `ai-gate-reviewer.png` | AI gate reviewer |
| `pr-shepherd.png` | PR shepherd |
| `product-manager.png` | Product manager |
| `data-analytics.png` | Data analytics |
| `business-analyst.png` | Business analyst |
